intent: Define the semantic identity, purpose, and interpretation rules of the UBVM README as the authoritative conceptual entrypoint for the Universal Behavioural Virtual Machine.

interpretation.this_is: The official README for UBVM — the reference runtime for SCP capsules.
purpose: Establish UBVM's identity and conceptual surface
Explain core constructs: capsules, primitives, triggers, interpreter
Define UBVM's role within the Forge Theory ecosystem
Provide a stable mental model for developers and architects
audience: Architects integrating UBVM into larger systems
importance: Relationship to SCP and Forge Theory
ignore: Implementation-specific quirks not part of the conceptual model
dont_change: UBVM's role as the reference runtime

guarantees: Terminology in this README is canonical for UBVM.
Concept definitions override comments or code-level interpretations.
UBVM's identity and purpose remain stable across versions.
This README defines the mental model for all UBVM-compliant runtimes.
non_guarantees: Implementation details of the reference runtime.
Experimental primitives or features not yet in UBVM Core.
semantic_contract.conflict_resolution: If contradictions arise, prefer this README over code comments, logs, or external documentation.

provenance.context: Created during UBVM documentation session, May 2026. Revised to move semantic_contract into interpretation, add provenance, correct capture_mode, add daily validation behaviour, and add scp/spec link.
